executive_summary: CISA has added four actively exploited vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, requiring federal agencies to patch by July 10, 2026. The most critical is CVE-2026-48282, a maximum-severity (CVSS 10/10) remote code execution flaw in Adobe ColdFusion already under active attack. Additionally, CVE-2026-55255 in Langflow is being exploited for credential harvesting. Major data breaches dominate the landscape: Japanese telecom giant KDDI disclosed a breach affecting over 12 million people, and Accenture confirmed a security incident following claims that 35GB of source code and Azure credentials were stolen. Canadian universities are being targeted by threat actor UNK_MassTraction exploiting Roundcube vulnerabilities, and Mount Royal University suffered a ransomware attack exposing student and staff data.

canada_landscape.summary: Canadian universities are under active attack by threat actor UNK_MassTraction exploiting Roundcube vulnerabilities targeting physics and engineering departments. Mount Royal University disclosed a ransomware attack that exposed student and staff data. No CCCS advisories were identified in the monitoring period, though Canadian institutions remain in the crosshairs of advanced persistent threat groups.

report_2w.executive_summary: Canadian government (CCCS) has issued critical alerts for two actively exploited vulnerabilities: CVE-2026-45659 in Microsoft SharePoint Server and CVE-2026-8451 in Citrix NetScaler. The Intercept's Signal tip line was breached by an unknown actor who has been soliciting whistleblowers since February. Threat actor ShinyHunters claims a 40GB breach of the University of Nottingham, and Qilin ransomware group published 539GB of NOI Hotels data. Multiple North Korea-linked campaigns are targeting developers through malicious npm packages that steal secrets the moment repositories are opened in VS Code.

canada_landscape.summary: Canadian Centre for Cyber Security (CCCS) issued two critical alerts this week: AL26-015 for Microsoft SharePoint Server CVE-2026-45659 and AL26-016 for Citrix NetScaler CVE-2026-8451, both requiring immediate patching. No specific breaches of major Canadian retailers or financial institutions were identified in this reporting period, though general discussions of Canadian political and social topics appeared in non-security contexts.
